ProjectPulse User Guide×

Getting Started

ProjectPulse is a complete project management suite. Create a new project by entering a name and team members, or load a sample project to explore the features.

Quick start: Click a sample (Web Redesign / Mobile App) to instantly see all features in action with pre-loaded data.

File Operations

  • Export Project Excel — Downloads the entire project as a multi-sheet Excel file with an executive dashboard.
  • Settings — Configure custom fields, step templates, and project metadata.

The File menu shows storage status: ● Auto-saving when connected to an Excel file, or ● Local storage when using browser storage only.

Tasks

  • Add Task (Ctrl+N) — Create tasks with category, assignee, priority, dates, and estimated days.
  • Inline editing — Click any cell to edit directly in the table.
  • Sub-tasks — Expand a task row to manage sub-steps with their own status and assignee.
  • Dependencies — Set task dependencies; blocked tasks cannot be started until dependencies are complete.
  • State transitions — Enforced valid status changes (e.g., "Completed" → cannot move back). Comments required for On Hold/Cancelled.
  • Actual Days Auto-calc — Effort is automatically calculated when you set a Completion Date, intelligently filtering out weekends.

🧠 Smart Scheduling

  • Business Day Logic — All due dates and effort calculations ignore Saturdays and Sundays to reflect real-world work capacity.
  • Assignee-Aware Timelines — For GUI tasks, sub-steps (screens) assigned to the same person are scheduled sequentially. Those assigned to different people run in parallel.
  • Resource Leveling — The parent task's Due Date automatically extends if a single resource is overloaded, helping you balance team capacity.

📅 Timeline (Gantt Chart)

  • Canvas-rendered Gantt chart with color-coded status bars and progress fill.
  • Dependency arrows shown between linked tasks.
  • Today marker — Red dashed line showing current date.
  • Zoom controls — Day / Week / Month granularity.
  • Tasks must have Start Date and Due Date to appear on the timeline.

🔍 Filtering (Multi-Select)

  • Sidebar chips support multi-select — click multiple status/priority/assignee chips to filter by their union.
  • Click "All" to clear a filter category.
  • Use the search bar (Ctrl+K) for text search across all task fields.

Team Management

  • Add team members with roles, phone, email, birthdays, and reporting structure.
  • Auto-generated org chart visualization.
  • Team members auto-populate the assignee dropdown in tasks.

Reports & Dashboard

  • Status Reports — Create periodic reports with auto-populated activities, achievements, risks, and plans.
  • 📧 Email Report — Send reports via your email client with pre-filled content.
  • Executive Dashboard — Progress ring, status/priority charts, team workload, resource utilization.
  • Advanced Analytics — Burndown chart, weekly velocity, cumulative flow diagram, and predictive completion estimates.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Ctrl+N — New task  |  Ctrl+K — Search  |  Esc — Close modals  |  F1 — Help

Tips

  • Custom fields can be added in Settings → Custom Fields (Text, Number, Date, Dropdown, Checkbox types).
  • Step templates let you quickly add predefined sub-task workflows to any task.
  • Birthday reminders appear in the sidebar — current month birthdays are highlighted.
  • The activity log tracks every change made to any task, including field-level history.
  • Best experience in Chrome or Edge for File System Access API support.

Project Date Reference Guide
ProjectPulse tracks multiple date dimensions per task to support schedule baseline comparisons, actual progress tracking, and predictive forecasting.
Date Type UI Header Definition & Usage
Planned Schedule Start / Due The active execution dates. This is the timeline the team is working towards right now. Can be adjusted as variables change.
Schedule Baseline Base Start / Base Due The approved target schedule, frozen during baseline capture. Used as the static reference point to measure slippage and variance.
Forecast Schedule Forecast Due Predictive completion date calculated based on current progress velocity. Compares to Baseline Due to identify at-risk tasks early.
Actual Schedule Comp. Date The actual date when work on the task was completed (marked as 100% / Completed). Used to compute final pacing variance.
